title: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
description: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
no_spec_change_rationale: CI workflow ordering only; no canonical spec owns .github/workflows
acceptance_criteria: Each pull_request/push workflow (atlas.yml, checks.yml, trust.yml) starts with a job named Archive that checks out the head commit and runs CorvidLabs/spec-sync pinned to 106aaa43d0bcf049f19b173ddb63815a25c3f931 with archive-gate-only true, and every other job in those workflows needs it directly or transitively, so no other CI job runs while a SpecSync change under .specsync/changes/ is still open
